It was sponsored by [[Hyundai Motor Company]], and was held from 27 February to 5 December 2010. The [[2011 South Korean football match-fixing scandal|K League match-fixing scandal]], the biggest incident in history of South Korean football, occurred in this season, and was revealed in 2011. 15 matches were fixed by 47 players, and they were banned for life from working in football. ==Teams== {{location map+ |South Korea |float=right |width=250 |caption=Locations of the 2009 K League clubs |places= {{location map~ |South Korea |lat=35.244494 |long=129.070129 |label=
